description: Sprint backlog slipped by three weeks because of late requirement sign off and the milestone date is at risk.
Integration milestone delayed by a month due to environment readiness and the client wants a recovery plan.
Go live date for phase one is slipping again and the client sponsor is unhappy with repeated delays.
Client keeps adding new reports outside the agreed scope without a change request.
Scope has grown by thirty percent through verbal approvals and the team works unpaid extra hours.
Stakeholders request additional integrations late in the project and want them in the same release.
Two senior developers left the project and the remaining team cannot meet the sprint commitments.
Key architect pulled to another program and critical design work is blocked.
Testing team understaffed during release week and regression testing is incomplete.
Third party licence delivery arrived two weeks late and blocked the environment setup.
Vendor API for the payments integration is still not delivered and the vendor keeps missing agreed dates.
Payments API from the vendor is delayed again and blocking integration testing across teams.
Vendor missed the payments API delivery date for the third time and the integration milestone is blocked.
High number of open critical defects found in user acceptance testing.
Production release had major defects in billing calculation and the client requested root cause analysis.
Recurring defects in the reporting module after each release.
Project forecast shows a ten percent budget overrun due to extended testing effort.
Cost forecast is thirty percent above budget and the client has not agreed to additional funding.
Budget overrun raised by finance because change requests were never billed.
Product owner and technical lead disagree on priorities and decisions keep changing.
Two client business units give conflicting requirements and the steering committee is deadlocked.
Client stakeholder blames the team publicly in meetings and trust is declining.
